CustomField.description: System external-id key for this page, used by template clone and packaging tooling (FormTemplateClone_Controller, FormTemplate_Utility) to match a page to its counterpart across orgs/templates so relationships re-link correctly on copy. Indexed External Id text field. Maintained automatically — do not hand-edit; changing it can break clone matching and section re-parenting.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is a system key the package maintains automatically to track this page across template clones and deployments. Do not edit it by hand; altering the value can break cloning and break the links between this page and its sections.
CustomField.label: ExternalId
